entities.summary: Andreas Borgman is a Swedish professional ice hockey defenceman currently playing with HV71 in the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). Borgman was the recipient of the Swedish Hockey League Rookie of the Year honours for his achievements during the 2016–17 season.
